body.name: Feasible positive-weight clipped-IPW quantile
body.construction: Compute \(\widehat t_{a,n}\) by the explicit generalized inverse, set \(\widehat h_{a,n}=1/\widehat t_{a,n}\) and \(\widehat b_{a,n}=\vartheta_a\widehat p_{a,(\lceil\widehat h_{a,n}\rceil\wedge n)}\), and define \(\widehat q_a(\tau)\) as the smallest minimizer of \(q\mapsto\sum_k\sum_{i\in I_k}\mathbf1\{A_i=a\}\rho_\tau(Y_i-q)/(\widehat\pi_{a,-k}(X_i)\vee\widehat b_{a,n})\).
